expected_structural_delta: Architecture required because the change adds one shared PHP production module and routes four existing output consumers through it. Predicted delta: one encoding owner, four consumer edges, one output hop per consumer, one test file, no new state, persistence, protocol, or public operation.
minimum_design: Give the shared PHP output boundary one encoding owner for JSON substitution and UTF-8 HTML escaping. Route the endpoint and page consumers through native PHP flags, and test invalid bytes plus recursive JSON failure.
outcome: When APIs or form values contain invalid UTF-8, JSON responses remain valid and HTML form output substitutes invalid bytes. Valid UTF-8 output remains unchanged.

reuse_decisions.name: direct PHP JSON and HTML encoders
reuse_decisions.rationale: The base tree has repeated direct calls across the endpoint and pages. One shared encoding owner removes drift between output boundaries.

reuse_decisions.name: crf-core.php page include
reuse_decisions.rationale: The existing shared page core is the common include path for tab pages, but the endpoint has a separate entrypoint. Keep page loading explicit and reuse the existing include pattern.

reuse_decisions.name: new encoding helper
reuse_decisions.rationale: JSON serialization and HTML escaping are shared output contracts across separate entrypoints. A small helper owns those boundary flags without adding state or changing application decisions.

reuse_decisions.name: tests/utf8-safety.sh
reuse_decisions.rationale: A focused PHP fixture is needed to prove invalid-byte substitution, escaping, and the non-UTF-8 fallback response.
